title: Magnolia officinalis Rehder & E.H.Wilson. Bark Extract and Magnolol Alleviate Allergic Rhinitis via Modulating NF-kappaB/MAPK Signaling.
authors: Huang, Leyuan; Zhou, Xu; He, Guanfeng; Li, Haixin; Chen, Xiaoying; Xu, Jingwen; Zhou, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究厚朴提取物和厚朴酚通过NF-κB/MAPK信号通路缓解过敏性鼻炎，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症通路与药效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Magnolia officinalis Rehder & E.H.Wilson. bark is famous as a traditional herbal medicine used in prescriptions for treating gastrointestinal discomfort, respiratory and inflammatory disorders. Magnolol, one of its principal bioactive constituents, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties. However, its therapeutic mechanisms in allergic rhinitis (AR) remain to be elucidated. In this study, the anti-allergic effects and molecular mechanisms of M. officinalis bark aqueous extract (MOAE) and magnolol were investigated using an ovalbumin (OVA)-induced AR mouse model. Nasal symptoms, histopathological alterations, and serum inflammatory mediators, including histamine and immunoglobulins (IgE, IgG1, IgG2a), were evaluated to assess efficacy. Both MOAE and magnolol significantly alleviated nasal rubbing and sneezing, reduced eosinophil infiltration and mucus hypersecretion, and improved tissue morphology in nasal and lung sections. Moreover, treatment markedly decreased serum levels of histamine and OVA-specific antibodies. Integrative network pharmacology, RNA sequencing, and molecular docking analyses revealed 33 co-regulated target genes mainly involved in the NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways, suggesting that modulation of these pathways underlies the observed anti-inflammatory effects. These findings demonstrate that MOAE and magnolol exert protective effects against AR through the regulation of key inflammatory signaling cascades. This study provides modern pharmacological evidence supporting the traditional use of M.officinalis bark and highlights its potential as a natural therapeutic candidate for AR.
abstract_zh: 厚朴（Magnolia officinalis Rehder & E.H.Wilson）树皮作为传统草药而闻名，常用于治疗胃肠不适、呼吸系统及炎症性疾病的处方中。和厚朴酚（magnolol）是其主要的生物活性成分之一，具有强效的抗炎和免疫调节特性。然而，其在过敏性鼻炎（AR）中的治疗机制仍有待阐明。本研究利用卵清蛋白（OVA）诱导的AR小鼠模型，探讨了厚朴树皮水提物（MOAE）和和厚朴酚的抗过敏效应及分子机制。通过评估鼻部症状、组织病理学改变以及血清炎症介质（包括组胺和免疫球蛋白IgE、IgG1、IgG2a）来评价疗效。MOAE和和厚朴酚均显著减轻了鼻抓挠和打喷嚏，减少了嗜酸性粒细胞浸润和黏液过度分泌，并改善了鼻部和肺部切片的组织形态。此外，治疗显著降低了血清中组胺和OVA特异性抗体的水平。整合网络药理学、RNA测序和分子对接分析揭示了33个共调控靶基因，主要涉及NF-kappaB和MAPK信号通路，表明这些通路的调节是所观察到的抗炎效应的基础。这些发现证明，MOAE和和厚朴酚通过调节关键炎症信号级联对AR发挥保护作用。本研究为厚朴树皮的传统应用提供了现代药理学证据，并凸显其作为AR天然治疗候选药物的潜力。
